On this walk you interpret leisure, sacred water and local traditions in Mehrauli.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Jahaz Mahal exterior
  • Hauz-i-Shamsi perimeter
  • Public village lane
  • Landscape viewpoint

How the time is spent

  1. Jahaz Mahal exterior 20 min

    Discuss water, leisure and Sultanate-period interpretations.

    You: draw building

  2. Hauz-i-Shamsi perimeter 35 min

    Distinguish legend from historical record.

    You: water timeline

  3. Public village lane 30 min

    Observe living practices and change.

    You: ethnographic ethics card

  4. Landscape viewpoint 20 min

    Relate waterbody to historic settlement.

    You: map contextual features

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Jahaz Mahal & Hauz-i-Shamsi using material evidence and a site map.
  • Interpret leisure, sacred water and local traditions in Mehrauli.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Where
Mehrauli, Delhi
For

Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.
Entry fees
Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
